description: A question asked of Siren in public (docs/free-tier.md). Siren answers the record's text on its own site, with the asker's handle, and takes the page down when the record is deleted. A follow-up names the question it replies to and its thread's root, as Bluesky replies do.

text.description: The question, at most 600 characters as the chat counts them (UTF-16 units).

city.description: The id of a city Siren serves, such as norfolk.

reply.description: For a follow-up: the question it replies to (parent) and the first question of its thread (root).
